_note: One spec per input deck, saved as scaffold/specs/<OriginalName>.json. Exactly 14 entries in new_slides. 'after', 'template_slide', 'figure.from_slide' and 'integrates' use ORIGINAL slide positions (1-46). Captions, citations and references are copied character for character from the deck. 'moves' lists at least three of: mechanism, consequence, integration, method_logic, distinction, foundation.

new_slides.title: Claim sentence stating what the slide teaches
new_slides.cite: <short citations as the deck writes them>
cited_papers_used: <DOI of each cited paper whose full text informed the explanation>
refs: <full reference with DOI, copied from the original notes>
